name: Grilled Romaine, Steak & Berry Salad with Walnuts

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ribeye steak
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and quarter lettuce lengthwise. Rub cut sides with a little olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 heads romaine lettuce
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Place steak on grill/skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Place lettuce quarters, cut side down, on grill/skillet. Cook until charred and leaves begin to wilt, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

Peel and mince garlic. In a small saucepan, combine vinegar and garlic; bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to low. Stirring occasionally, simmer until liquid is reduced and thickened, 5-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ cups balsamic vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Wash, trim stem ends, and slice strawberries. Wash blueberries.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (454 g) pkg strawberries
3 (170 g) pkg blueberries

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, place lettuce cut side up on a plate and top with berries and steak slices. Sprinkle with walnuts and drizzle with balsamic reduction. Enjoy!
